68075-the-lenni-lenape-or-delaware-india.title: Or Delaware Indians
68075-the-lenni-lenape-or-delaware-india.creator: Edwin Robert Walker
68075-the-lenni-lenape-or-delaware-india.description: A book by Edwin Robert Walker. I presumed that the word “Delaware” was an Indian name, evolved by the savages themselves and by them bestowed upon the river and bay. I was well grown up before I learned that the word was originally three words “De La Warr,” and that it was the name of an ancient English family ennobled in the time of Edward II, who reigned from 1307 to 1327.

arxiv-2012-06461.title: Thermomagnetic Properties of QCD
arxiv-2012-06461.creator: Christoph P. Hofmann
arxiv-2012-06461.description: Abstract We explore the low-energy regime of quantum chromodynamics subjected to an external magnetic field by deriving the two-loop representations for the entropy density and the magnetization within chiral perturbation theory (CHPT). At fixed temperature, the entropy density drops when the magnetic field becomes stronger.

arxiv-2012-13870.title: A Neural Network with Plane Wave Activation for Helmholtz Equation
arxiv-2012-13870.creator: Ziming Wang, Tao Cui, and Xueshuang Xiang \corrauth
arxiv-2012-13870.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Ziming Wang, Tao Cui, and Xueshuang Xiang \corrauth. This paper proposes a plane wave activation based neural network (PWNN) for solving Helmholtz equation, the basic partial differential equation to represent wave propagation, e.g. acoustic wave, electromagnetic wave, and seismic wave.

arxiv-2108-07321.title: The Clustering of Orbital Poles Induced by the LMC: Hints for the Origin of Planes of Satellites Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2108-07321.creator: Nicolás Garavito-Camargo, Ekta Patel, Gurtina Besla, Adrian M. Price-Whelan, Facundo A. Gómez, Chervin F.P Laporte, Kathryn V. Johnston
arxiv-2108-07321.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Nicolás Garavito-Camargo, Ekta Patel, Gurtina Besla, Adrian M. Price-Whelan, Facundo A. Gómez, Chervin F.P Laporte, Kathryn V. Johnston. A significant fraction of Milky Way (MW) satellites exhibit phase-space properties consistent with a coherent orbital plane. Using tailored N–body simulations of a spherical MW halo that recently captured a massive (1.8 × 10 11 \times 10^{11} M ⊙ \odot ) LMC-like satellite, we identify the physical mechanisms that may enhance the clustering of orbital poles of objects orbiting the MW.

arxiv-2204-00077.title: Efficient Maximal Coding Rate Reduction by Variational Forms
arxiv-2204-00077.creator: Christina BaekCarnegie Mellon University kbaek@cs.cmu.edu *equal contribution, Ziyang WuInternational Digital Economy Academy wuziyang@idea.edu.cn *equal contribution Kwan Ho Ryan ChanJohns Hopkins University kchan49@jhu.edu Tianjiao DingJohns Hopkins University tding@jhu.edu Yi MaUniversity of Cali
arxiv-2204-00077.description: Abstract The principle of Maximal Coding Rate Reduction (MCR 2 ) has recently been proposed as a training objective for learning discriminative low-dimensional structures intrinsic to high-dimensional data to allow for more robust training than standard approaches, such as cross-entropy minimization.

arxiv-2305-01746.title: Emergent U(1) symmetry in non-particle-conserving one-dimensional models
arxiv-2305-01746.creator: Zakaria Jouini, Natalia Chepiga, Loïc Herviou, Frédéric Mila
arxiv-2305-01746.description: Abstract The properties of stable Luttinger liquid phases in models with a non-conserved number of particles are investigated. We study the Luttinger liquid phases in one-dimensional models of hard-core boson and spinless fermion chains where particles can be created and annihilated three by three on adjacent sites.

arxiv-2309-00330.title: Multitask Deep Learning for Accurate Risk Stratification and Prediction of Next Steps for Coronary CT Angiography Patients
arxiv-2309-00330.creator: Juan Lu, Mohammed Bennamoun, Jonathon Stewart, Jason K. Eshraghian, Yanbin Liu, Benjamin Chow, Frank M. Sanfilippo, Girish Dwivedi
arxiv-2309-00330.description: Abstract Diagnostic investigation has an important role in risk stratification and clinical decision making of patients with suspected and documented Coronary Artery Disease (CAD). However, the majority of existing tools are primarily focused on the selection of gatekeeper tests, whereas only a handful of systems contain information regarding the downstream testing or treatment.

arxiv-2310-02433.description: Abstract The offline software framework of the LHCb experiment has undergone a significant overhaul to tackle the data processing challenges that will arise in the upcoming Run 3 and Run 4 of the Large Hadron Collider. This paper introduces FunTuple , a novel component developed for offline data processing within the LHCb experiment.

arxiv-2403-04357.title: IMU Tracking of Kinematic Chains in the Absence of Gravitational and Magnetic Fields
arxiv-2403-04357.description: Abstract Context/Background: Tracking kinematic chains has many uses from healthcare to virtual reality. Inertial measurement units (IMUs) are well-recognised for their body tracking capabilities, however, existing solutions rely on gravity and often magnetic fields for drift correction. As humanity’s presence in space increases, systems that don’t rely on gravity or magnetism are required.

arxiv-2405-19700.description: Abstract The SNO+ collaboration reports its first spectral analysis of long-baseline reactor antineutrino oscillation using 114 tonne-years of data. Fitting the neutrino oscillation probability to the observed energy spectrum yields constraints on the neutrino mass-squared difference Δ ​ m 21 2 \Delta m^{2}_{21} .

arxiv-2602-06547.description: Abstract Third-party agent skills extend LLM-based agents with instruction files and executable code that run on users’ machines. pmc-10651747.title: Neocortical and cerebellar malformations affect flurothyl-induced seizures in female C57BL/6J mice
pmc-10651747.creator: Katherine M. Keever, Ying Li, Paige D. Womble, D. Gregory Sullens, Gonzalo H. Otazu, Joaquin N. Lugo, Raddy L. Ramos
pmc-10651747.description: Brain malformations cause cognitive disability and seizures in both human and animal models. Highly laminated structures such as the neocortex and cerebellum are vulnerable to malformation, affecting lamination and neuronal connectivity as well as causing heterotopia. The objective of the present study was to determine if sporadic neocortical and/or cerebellar malformations in C57BL/6J mice are correlated with reduced seizure threshold.

pmc-10683559.title: Expanding the horizons of porphyrin metal–organic frameworks via catecholate coordination: exploring structural diversity, material stability and redox properties†
pmc-10683559.creator: Siddhartha De, Georges Mouchaham, Fangbing Liu, Maame Affram, Brian Abeykoon, Nathalie Guillou, Erwann Jeanneau, Jean-Marc Grenèche, Lhoussain Khrouz, Charlotte Martineau-Corcos, Lotfi Boudjema, Fabrice Salles, Pablo Salcedo-Abraira, Gonçalo Valente, Manuel Souto, Alexandra Fateeva, Thomas Devic
pmc-10683559.description: Porphyrin based Metal–Organic Frameworks (MOFs) have generated high interest because of their unique combination of light absorption, electron transfer and guest adsorption/desorption properties. In this study, we expand the range of available MOF materials by focusing on the seldom studied porphyrin ligand H10TcatPP, functionalized with tetracatecholate coordinating groups.

pmc-11332377.title: SILICONE FINE-NEEDLE ASPIRATION RETINAL BIOPSY
pmc-11332377.creator: Mojca Globočnik Petrovič, Nika Vrabič, Veronika Prevodnik Kloboves, Simona Miceska, Ana Pajtler Rošar, Nataša Vidovič Valentinčič
pmc-11332377.description: A 41-gauge silicone fine-needle aspirational biopsy is valuable for obtaining high-quality retinal and subretinal samples when primary intraocular lymphoma is suspected. The technique provides high-quality samples for cytologic analysis. Intraocular lymphoma is a diagnostically challenging condition, especially when ocular tissue is the site of primary involvement.

pmc-12533920.title: Treatment outcomes in lower limb lymphedema misdiagnosed as iliac vein compression syndrome: A retrospective analysis
pmc-12533920.creator: Guijun Huo, Mingqing Du, Zhichao Yao, Dayong Zhou, Zhanao Liu
pmc-12533920.description: Iliac vein compression is highly prevalent in the general population, which may lead to misdiagnosis of lower limb lymphedema as iliac vein compression syndrome and subsequent stent placement. This study retrospectively analyzed the treatment outcomes of 11 patients with secondary lymphedema who had previously been diagnosed with iliac vein compression by venography and underwent iliac vein stenting.

pmc-12609595.title: Effectiveness of Soil, Foliar, and Seed Selenium Applications in Modulating Physio-Biochemical, and Yield Responses to Drought Stress in Vegetable Soybean (Glycine max L. Merrill)
pmc-12609595.creator: Masego Sekhurwane, Brigitta Tóth, Makoena Joyce Moloi
pmc-12609595.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Drought stress severely affects the physio-biochemical processes and yield of nutritious crops like vegetable soybean (Glycine max L. Merrill), threatening global food security and emphasising the need for effective strategies to improve drought tolerance.

pmc-13073719.title: Extracranial Metastases in Glioblastoma, IDH-Wildtype: A Case Series
pmc-13073719.creator: Valèria Richart, Marta García de Herreros, Juan Andrés Mora, Camilo Pineda, Iban Aldecoa, Estela Pineda, Izaskun Valduvieco, José Juan González, Laura Oleaga, Sofía González-Ortiz
pmc-13073719.description: Background: Extracranial metastasis (EM) from glioblastoma (GB), IDH-wildtype (WHO CNS 2021 grade 4) is rare and often under-recognized, yet it has immediate implications for staging and management. We report a case series integrating advanced neuroimaging, whole-body imaging, and pathology/biomarkers to characterize imaging–pathology correlates of EM and highlight practical clinical triggers that should prompt systemic evaluation.
